facts.text: The hotel sits on the shores of Talamanca Bay in Ibiza.
facts.excerpt: Nobu Hotel Ibiza Bay is ideally positioned on the shores of Talamanca Bay.

facts.text: Guests can step from the hotel straight onto the sandy beach.
facts.excerpt: step from the hotel straight onto the soft sandy beach - or your yacht

facts.text: The beach promenade is right outside, and a short walk leads to the boutiques and restaurants of Marina Botafoch and the old town.
facts.excerpt: With the beach promenade right outside your door, in a short walk you will be wandering through the trendy boutiques and restaurants of Marina Botafoch and old town.

facts.text: Dalt Vila and Ibiza Old Town are 10 minutes away by car.
facts.excerpt: Dalt Vila and Ibiza Old Town**: 10 minutes by car

facts.text: The airport is 12 minutes away by car.
facts.excerpt: Airport**: 12 minutes by car

facts.text: The Pacha club is 2 minutes away by car.
facts.excerpt: Pacha: 2 minutes by car

facts.text: Rooms use soft furnishings in a palette of whites, golds, blues and aqua.
facts.excerpt: Rooms are adorned with soft furnishings, using a color palette of whites, golds, blues, and aqua.

facts.text: Rooms have floor-to-ceiling windows and open terraces.
facts.excerpt: Floor-to-ceiling windows and open terraces mean you will wake to the scent of wild jasmine and fall asleep to the sound of the waves.

facts.text: Rooms and suites combine locally sourced Ibizan artwork with modern conveniences.
facts.excerpt: Discover a chic combination of locally sourced Ibizan artwork and sleek modern conveniences in our rooms and suites.

facts.text: Room details include hand-crafted ceramics and natural woven lamps.
facts.excerpt: Tasteful details like hand-crafted ceramics, natural woven lamps

facts.text: The Grand Suites are the Penthouse, Presidential, Royal Suite, Rooftop Junior Suite and One-bedroom Suite Seaview.
facts.excerpt: Our Penthouse, Presidential, Royal Suite, Rooftop Junior Suite and One-bedroom Suite Seaview

facts.text: Bedrooms look out to sea and sunrise views of the Illa Grossa peninsula and the Cap Martinet headland.
facts.excerpt: complements the jaw-dropping sea (and sunrise) views of the craggy Illa Grossa peninsula and the headland of Cap Martinet

facts.text: The hotel has two outdoor pools facing the sea, steps from the beach.
facts.excerpt: Our two outdoor pools, facing the sea and just steps from the beach

facts.text: The adults pool has oversized day-beds and sun loungers.
facts.excerpt: Our adults pool offers oversized day-beds and sun loungers

facts.text: A quieter family pool sits close to the Kid's Club.
facts.excerpt: Close to the Kid’s Club, our more tranquil family pool

facts.text: All loungers are complimentary for guests.
facts.excerpt: All loungers are complimentary for our guests.

facts.text: Bali beds around the adults pool require a minimum food and drink spend.
facts.excerpt: Bali beds around the adults' pool require minimum f&b consumption.

facts.text: The spa is Ibiza Bay Spa by Six Senses.
facts.excerpt: Indulgence and serenity cohabit peacefully at Ibiza Bay Spa by Six Senses.

facts.text: The spa offers skincare products and treatments by Dr. Barbara Sturm.
facts.excerpt: Discover a range of exclusive skincare products and treatments by **Dr. Barbara Sturm**

facts.text: Dogs are welcome, and the hotel has a Dog Spaw created with Charlie & Co Naturals.
facts.excerpt: At Ibiza Bay, everybody is welcome, including your beloved pup. Indulge your four-legged friend with Ibiza’s one and only **Dog Spaw**, created in partnership with Charlie & Co Naturals

facts.text: The hotel runs Holistic Hikes Retreats with Ibiza Hike Station.
facts.excerpt: In partnership with leading industry experts **Ibiza Hike Station**, we present the **Holistic Hikes Retreats**.

facts.text: The Kid's Club is for children aged 4 to 12.
facts.excerpt: **Ages**: Children 4 – 12

facts.text: The Kid's Club offers DJ workshops for children.
facts.excerpt: then our DJ workshops are a must

facts.text: Kid's Club activities include pool games, yoga sessions and paddleboarding in the bay.
facts.excerpt: Mini sports lovers can push themselves to the limit with classic pool games, yoga sessions or paddleboarding in the bay.

facts.text: A babysitter service is available.
facts.excerpt: Babysitter service available.

facts.text: The Almacen boutique sells local and international brands including clothing, swimwear, ceramics, beauty products and jewelry.
facts.excerpt: Discover local and international lifestyle brands including clothing, swimwear, ceramics, beauty products, and jewelry.

facts.text: The Nobu restaurant serves Nobu Matsuhisa's signature Japanese dishes such as Yellowtail Sashimi with Jalapeno and Black Cod Miso.
facts.excerpt: Savour Nobu Matsuhisa's signature Japanese dishes, such as Tiradito, Yellowtail Sashimi with Jalapeno, and Black Cod Miso

facts.text: Chambao is the hotel's laid-back chiringuito beach restaurant.
facts.excerpt: Chambao is Nobu Hotel Ibiza Bay’s laidback chiringuito beach restaurant.

facts.text: The Rooftop draws hotel guests and locals at sunset and into the night.
facts.excerpt: The place to be as the sun goes down and the night warms up, for hotel guests and locals alike

facts.text: A boardwalk curves across the sands of the bay.
facts.excerpt: A snaking boardwalk loops and curves across the sands

facts.text: The hotel is open until 26 October this season.
facts.excerpt: A Little More Summer Open until 26 October

facts.text: Conde Nast Traveler readers chose the hotel in its Readers' Choice Awards in 2019, 2020 and 2025.
facts.excerpt: Readers' Choice Awards 2019, 2020, 2025

facts.text: Conde Nast Traveler calls the staff arguably the best on the island.
facts.excerpt: Staff—arguably the best on the island—know guests by name
